prompt:
A benchmark records token counts and cost per call. Providers differ: some report both, some report token counts only, and a local one reports neither. The schema makes these fields nullable and the report prints 'n/a' when absent. A reviewer proposes defaulting them to 0 so averages always compute.

Cost figures are used to decide whether one configuration is cheaper than another.

Decide whether nullable is the defect the reviewer says it is.

Verdict convention: answer `pass` if the thing described is sound as it stands, and `fail` if it is defective. The verdict describes the thing under review, never any proposal mentioned about it.
